content: Midseled a ziyà te pemuleey ku, pelanggè ku he minahal. Mid-amur-amur ku is mira ku wey menge pehemut ku. Migkaan a te teneb ku wey mid-inum a te vinu ku wey ǥatas ku. Menge Bahi ziyà te Jerusalem Sikiyu is mibminahalà, megkaan kew wey med-inum.
Dutun te nekelipezeng a ne neketeǥeinep a. Nezineg ku he ebpeneǥuktuk is minahal ku. Ke sikandin te, “Puwasi a, pelanggè ku he mekempet. Su nahames en is ulu ku te zehemug.”
Piru migkaǥi a te, “Neluwas ku en is kumbalè ku, ne id-uman ku en be maan heini idseluub? Neledlezan kud is menge paa ku, ne ed-umanan ku en be maan heini eburingi?”
Midsikep duen te minahal ku is terangka te gemawan, ne zutun utew a nelipey.
Mid-enew a is ibpeseled ku sikandin. Ne hein migewezan ku is gewezà duen te ǥemawan midtiǥis diyà te velad ku is mira.
Mibpuwasan ku is minahal ku, piru wazè en sikandin. Egkesuat a he mezineg ku is laǥeng din. Umbe mid-umew ku sikandin, piru wazè en sikandin medtavak. Mibpen-ehè ku sikandin, piru wazè ku meturedu.
Naahà a te menge vantey zutun te kedrunda zan diyà te inged. Midlagkut e zan ne nepelian a. Migkuwa zan is samput ku.
Sikiyu is menge vahi te Jerusalem, penangdù kew he emun egkeehè niw is minahal ku ne keǥiyi niw sikandin he midluyahan a tenged te kebmahal.
Sikew is kezegwayan he vahi, hengkey is meupiya ziyà te minahal nu su ibpepenangdù key man kenikew? Edhuna ve sikandin he meupiya kenà te zuma?
Mekempet wey meriǥàriǥà is minahal ku. Te sepulù he libu he menge maama, ne iyan sikandin edhuna.
Edhuna pa he mevali is ulu zin kenà te vulawan. Mekurkuruten is bulvul zin ne iring keitem te uwak.
Is mata zin iring kekempet te mata te merepatik he iring keputì te gatas, he ziyà te veyvey te wahig. Ne iring heini kekempet te mahalen he menge vatu.
Is enaping din mehemut iring te pemuleey he neeneb te menge pinemula he ebeelan he pehemut. Is menge bivig din henduen be te menge liryu he edtudà duen is mira.
Is menge vekelawan din, ne henduen be te kebilya he vulawan he zuen duen mahalen he menge vatu. Is lawa zin henduen be te impesinew he ungal te ilipanti he nezeyzeyanan te menge vatu he sepiru.
Is menge vuvun din, ne henduen be te menge tukud he marmul he ziyà ipehitindeg te peuntuzà he lunsey he vulawan. Utew sikandin mekempet he ed-ahaan, iring te menge kayu he sidru ziyà te Lebanon.
Meupiya he edhezekan is bivig din, ne utew sikandin mekempet. He menge vahi te Jerusalem, iyan sikandin minahal ku; iyan sikandin emiǥu ku.
